# Offline inference fixtures

`tiny-llama/` is an original, deterministic two-layer Llama-compatible model
generated by `python3 crates/synapse-core/tests/fixtures/generate.py`. It uses no
upstream checkpoint or training data and carries the repository's license.
The random weights test mechanics and produce meaningless text.

The committed files include F32 safetensors, a WordLevel tokenizer, a complete
SHA-256 manifest, and independent scalar Python full-forward reference logits
and greedy tokens. The fixture deliberately uses grouped-query attention (four
query heads, two KV heads) so parity tests cover real attention routing.

Default tests perform no model network calls. To test a real model explicitly,
run the ignored `hub_download_is_pinned_and_verified` integration test with
`cargo test -p synapse-core --test model_reference -- --ignored`. Model downloads
require network access and are separate evidence from offline unit tests.
